title: Wah hamshakle nabi
body:
Wah hamshakle nabi
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar jamaal kudrat e parwardigar hai
Akbar khudai husn ka aaina daar hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Laila ka maan ibne Ali ka waqaar hai.
khaaliq ko jispe naaz ye wo shahkar hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiska nahi jawab ye wo lajawab hai.
Ye hubahu shabih e risalat ma'aab hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
Ho iske rubaru bhala kya daaghdaar chaand
<<DIVIDER>>
Muh abr me chhupake chale barbar chaand
Waise muhavre me to hote hai chaar chaand
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ne karbala ko lagaye hazaar chaand
Paya hai chehra misle payambar isiliye
<<DIVIDER>>
Rakha gaya hai naam bhi akbar isiliye
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Naa subho hai naa raat barabar ka waqt hai
Ibne Ali ke mehre munawwar ka waqt hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tafseer surah e rukhe anwar ka waqt hai
Ye zikr hazrat e ali akbar ka waqt hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tauqeer badrahi hai dar e buturaab ki
Aamad hai phir jahaa'n me risalat ma'aab ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
Shabbir ko wirasat e khairul wara mili
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ko shuja'at e shere khuda mili
Qasim ko azmate hasan e mujtaba mili
<<DIVIDER>>
Is ghar me shaan sabko khuda se juda mili
Zainab ne paya rutba e aala batul ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ko milgaya hai sarapa rasool ka
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Gesu bhi noor chehra e tahir bhi noor hai
Paikar bhi noor sina e aamir bhi noor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Baatin bhi iska noor hai zaahir bhi noor hai
Hadh ye ke is qaseede ka shayar bhi noor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Beta mila hai aisa nirala husain ko
Hairat se dekhta hai ujala husain ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
Ab tazkera hai akbar e khushruh ki jang ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaaro'n se dashte zaar me khushbu ki jang ka
Baazu e kirdigar ke baazu ki jang ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar chad ke bolte hue jaadu ki jang ka
Nazre uthake dekha to har saf ulatgai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud maut iske pairo se aake lipatgai
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ne tegh khaichi udhe beparo ke sar
Ki jab nigaha katgaye deedawaro ke sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Zadpar ajal ki aaye jo fitnagaro ke sar
Shaano se khud hi girne lage khudsaro ke saro
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha shor bhaago jang se haatho ko jhaadke
Lo aagaye Ali dar e khaibar ukhaadke
<<DIVIDER>>
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
Manzar ye kaarzaar ka kaise karu bayaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ki tegh aaj ajal ki hai tarjuma
Talwar ki chamak me tadapti hai bijliya'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaime ke dar pe shah e zamana hai SHADMAA'N
Ulti sipah NOOR Ali uske baar ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth uth ke daad di hai usey zulfiqar ne.
Wah hamshakle nabi.....x4
author: Shadman Raza
